section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction section defines body appreciation (BA) as accepting one's body regardless of size or cultural ideals, and discusses the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its revised version (BAS-2) as comprehensive measures of this construct. The authors note that while BA has been treated as a stable trait-like construct, it likely fluctuates across time and contexts, and they propose developing a state measure of BA. The section concludes by indicating that multiple studies will be reported to adapt and validate this new state measure of body appreciation.
